title: A sleepy shark
done: You made a sleepy shark! Shh. It is having a nap.

steps.say: Put a blue square flat on the table.
Put another blue square next to it. This is the shark's body.
Put a triangle at the end. That is its nose.
Put a triangle at the other end. That is its tail.
Put a triangle on top. The fin!
A small triangle under the body. The shark is yawning.
